title: lemdro.id · Interactions (who actually uses it)
description: Distinct users who commented, posted or voted (Influx lemdroid_interactions, hourly from obs-interactions on lemdroid-ovh; counts only, no user ids). Bots and mod-removed content excluded. Daily/weekly windows are UTC; the current window is partial until it closes.

list.name: where
list.label: Communities
list.description: all = whole site; lemdro.id = communities hosted here; remote = communities hosted elsewhere
list.query: all communities : all,lemdro.id communities : local,remote communities : remote

panels.title: Headline: distinct active users (last COMPLETE UTC day / ISO week; kind from the variable)
Local users · last full day
panels.description: lemdro.id accounts that commented/posted/voted anywhere (ignores Communities).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "lemdroid_interactions")
  |> range(start: -35d, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lemdroid_interactions" and r.period == "day" and r.scope == "site" and r.kind == "${kind}" and not exists r.community_local)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "users_local" or r._field == "complete")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.complete == true)
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last(column: "users_local")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "users_local"])

panels.title: Daily distinct users: local vs remote (${kind}, ${where})
panels.description: Local users on the right axis (they are far fewer).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "lemdroid_interactions")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lemdroid_interactions" and r.period == "day" and r.scope == "site" and (if "${where}" == "all" then not exists r.community_local else r.community_local == (if "${where}" == "local" then "true" else "false")))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.kind == "${kind}" and (r._field == "users_local" or r._field == "users_remote"))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "users_local" then "local users" else if r._field == "users_remote" then "remote users" else "all users"}))

panels.title: lemdro.id communities
panels.description: Communities hosted on lemdro.id, ranked by distinct people (local + remote) interacting.

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "lemdroid_interactions")
  |> range(start: -35d, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lemdroid_interactions" and r.period == "${period}" and r.scope == "community" and r.kind == "${kind}" and r.community_local == "true")
latest = data |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "users") |> keep(columns: ["_time"]) |> group()
  |> max(column: "_time") |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time == latest._time and r._field != "complete")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "community"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["users"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 25)
  |> keep(columns: ["community", "users", "users_local", "users_remote"])

panels.title: Where interactors come from (home instance, latest ${period})

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "lemdroid_interactions")
  |> range(start: -35d, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lemdroid_interactions" and r.period == "${period}" and r.scope == "site_home" and r.kind == "${kind}" and r._field == "users")
latest = data |> keep(columns: ["_time"]) |> group() |> max(column: "_time") |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time == latest._time and r.home_instance != "_other")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
  |> keep(columns: ["home_instance", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "users"})

options.content:
**How to read this**

* *Local users* = lemdro.id accounts. *Remote users* = accounts on other instances whose comments, posts or votes federated here.
* Each number is **distinct people** in the window, so days don't add up to a week.
* *any* = did at least one of comment / post / vote.
* Source: `obs_api.interactions()` on lemdroid-ovh (counts only), written hourly at :07 UTC to Influx bucket `lemdroid_interactions`; late federation is re-counted for 2 days.
